label_availability_assumption: Sale event date is a proxy; actual system arrival timestamp is unavailable. Cutoffs are strict.
duration_definition: Days from agreement to seizure / 30; not confirmed vehicle age
baseline_prediction: Original asset cost multiplied by training median sale-to-original-cost ratio

operational_role_rules.tuning: Seizure on/after 2026-01-01 and before 2026-03-01; label available before 2026-03-01
operational_role_rules.calibration: Seizure on/after 2026-03-01 and before 2026-05-01; label available before 2026-05-01
operational_role_rules.final_test: Seizure on/after 2026-05-01 with observed sale in the supplied dataset
operational_role_rules.excluded: Other records: old seizures with later sales, or outcome crosses its allocated development boundary

retrospective_role_rules: Partition by label availability: before Jan 1 train; Jan-Feb tuning; Mar-Apr calibration; May-Jul final_test. This is not an operational seizure-time replay.
test_access_policy: Phase 1 descriptive profiling included the entire file. Phase 2 does not compute model metrics or export target values for reserved roles. This is a model-development holdout, not a previously unseen external dataset.
future_phase_rule: Compare models on the same protocol and IDs. Do not change boundaries, bin edges or minimum counts after looking at final-test errors. Any changed experiment needs a new version and honest holdout status.
